question: After two independent pre-entry mechanisms failed, does V1's extreme-winner tail become distinguishable by the fifth observable holding-path session?
mechanism: Rare winners may be emergent trend-persistence events rather than entries identifiable by their pre-entry state. Early continuation would locate when the tail begins to separate under the frozen strategy.
prediction: Among trades observable through the fifth held session, day-5 close return is positively and stably associated with the fixed >=50% extreme-winner outcome after pre-entry controls; day-10 and day-20 survivor samples retain the direction.
interpretation_boundary: Day-5 return is part of the future holding path and terminal return. The experiment can locate emergence but cannot establish a causal, ex-ante, or tradable signal. Each landmark conditions on survival under the frozen exit logic.

sample.primary: return_5d is non-null under the frozen Phase 1 observable holding-path convention
sample.missingness: No imputation, carry-forward, post-exit price, or counterfactual return. Day-10/day-20 use their own survivor samples and cannot replace day-5.

primary_predictor: Frozen Phase 1 return_5d: close return on the fifth observable held-path session when the trade remains observable.

gates.raw: day-5 rho >= 0.20, positive within-year rank rho, and positive in >=7/8 LOYO estimates
gates.controlled: partial-rank rho >= 0.20 and positive in >=7/8 controlled LOYO estimates
gates.neighbors: day-10 and day-20 survivor-sample rhos are positive with >=6/8 LOYO positive signs; they cannot replace day-5
gates.falsification: positive ex-global-Top-4 P&L, holding-duration/exit partial rho >=0.10, and >=80% positive leave-one-extreme-security and leave-one-industry omissions

decision.DEEPEN: all raw, controlled, neighbor, and falsification gates pass
decision.REFINE: raw and controlled pass but neighbor or mechanical falsification fails

falsification: within-entry-year ranks and eight LOYO omissions
fixed pre-entry V1, market, breadth, beta, and liquidity controls
holding duration and exit reason as explicit post-outcome mechanical sensitivity
zero post-exit prices, counterfactual returns, replays, or missing-value substitution
forbidden: calling day-5 return an entry predictor, causal edge, or deployable signal
choosing a different landmark after results
imputing returns after an actual exit
exit, hold, stop, entry, ranking, exposure, or production modification
breadth historical redesign or invalid Phase 7/8/9 use
